execution_policy: Docs are drafted; only D00 local prerequisites are validated. No feature implementation is approved by this file.

slices.title: Install pinned local Go and establish baseline tests
slices.acceptance: Verified Go archive and OSS release; helper/unit/integration/vet evidence with explicit skips.

slices.title: Reconcile runtime contracts with architecture PRs
slices.acceptance: Correct #8 contracts; refresh #25 without reverting parent fixes; pinned source references.

slices.title: Complete and approve the v23.2 capability inventory
slices.acceptance: Audit public feature index, classify existing support and uncertainty, pin target semantics and record maintainer-accepted scope.

slices.title: Route a named feature through ordinary-core or cleanroom review
slices.acceptance: For each feature separately: permitted-core classification or named spec author, behavior-only spec, maintainer approval and separate implementer; no blanket approval.

slices.title: Repair the external backup's destructive and type-safety boundaries
slices.acceptance: Reject invalid/wildcard advertised hosts before drops; fix or refuse unsafe COPY; preserve rows on refusal; address known #17 review items.

slices.title: Prove external backup value and schema fidelity
slices.acceptance: Exact values/types/privileges scope, corruption and interruption, GC expiry, sequences, old artifacts, local/S3 and failed-restore preservation.

slices.title: Deliver an external scheduled-backup feature
slices.acceptance: Versioned schedule plan, overlap/lease fencing, retry, bounded cancellation, timezone, secret handling and safe retention; backup chains not pruned unsafely.

slices.title: Deliver independently versioned artifact encryption
slices.acceptance: Approved protection contract; authenticated integrity, key recovery/rotation, truncation and wrong-key tests; S3 SSE scope remains separately labeled.

slices.title: Characterize inherited SQL/driver/transaction semantics
slices.acceptance: Driver protocol matrix, error codes, serializable retries, ambiguity handling, exact type behavior and explicit unsupported cases.

slices.title: Establish distributed durability and availability evidence
slices.acceptance: Majority/minority, crashes, node replacement, split/merge, partitions and disk fault campaigns; consistency invariants beyond a single-key register.

slices.title: Integrate a native logical-backup job/control plane
slices.acceptance: Refactor reusable behavior behind a reviewed interface; no exec of CLI from node; durable progress, repeat-safe effects, ownership transfer, cancellation and auth.

slices.title: Build the candidate OSS server with the external backup retained
slices.acceptance: Actual candidate build; disallowed-import test; binary identity; artifact checksums; ship compatible independent CLI fallback with a support matrix.

slices.title: Test the candidate and fallback together
slices.acceptance: Same logical backup corpus through native and external paths; native crash/adoption/cancel tests; mixed-version/rollback; reject format mismatches and verify restore after release packaging.

slices.title: Complete the scoped native SQL backup/restore contract
slices.acceptance: Approved SQL syntax, scope, result and SQLSTATE contracts, privilege and transaction behavior, job control, old/new artifact handling and independent conformance tests. Explicitly decide Enterprise backup-file interchange; internal job integration alone is not parity.

slices.title: Add incremental export and chain recovery
slices.acceptance: Capture inserts/updates/deletes/DDL over an explicit interval, atomic progress, chain manifests and interrupted-layer recovery; no updated_at polling substitute.

slices.title: Add revision history and point-in-time restore
slices.acceptance: Protect required history, restore chosen times across DDL/deletes/transactions, reject gaps and expired intervals; prove chain retention safety.

slices.title: Add locality-aware and cluster-operational recovery coverage
slices.acceptance: Approved locality rules and complete declared catalog/security/schedule recovery; explicit unsupported operational state; cross-region restore drills.

slices.title: Add durable changefeed delivery
slices.acceptance: Consistent initial scan and changes/deletes; declared at-least-once or stronger contract; deterministic event identity, backpressure and sink faults.

slices.title: Add checkpoint/frontier and topology conformance
slices.acceptance: Resume without omissions across split/merge/restart; define resolved progress, schema transitions, duplicate delivery and slow consumers.

slices.title: Add physical cross-cluster recovery
slices.acceptance: Approved v23.2 target: consistent bootstrap/catchup/cutover, transactionally valid destination, bounded measured loss and recovery; failback only if separately scoped.

slices.title: Add multi-region policy and follower-read coverage
slices.acceptance: Document supported placement policies, test region-loss survival/residency, and identify actual serving replicas and staleness bounds.

slices.title: Add native store-key lifecycle
slices.acceptance: Approved encryption boundary, crash-safe key rotation and restore/restart recovery, no key leakage; filesystem encryption not silently counted.

slices.title: Add missing identity and audit behaviors
slices.acceptance: Fine-grained scope inventory; JWT/identity expiry and rotation, role mapping, policy audit delivery/redaction, and denied-access tests.

slices.title: Fill documented SQL language and isolation gaps
slices.acceptance: Inventory procedures/UDF/isolation cases first; implement only gaps with exact SQL/error/transaction semantics and upgrade tests.

slices.title: Close scoped observability gaps
slices.acceptance: Named metrics and result contracts, privileged visibility, retention and measured overhead; avoid rebuilding already present diagnostics.

slices.title: Accept the declared v23.2 parity profile
slices.acceptance: Every scoped behavior/dimension has passing candidate evidence; no unknowns hidden; independent fault/upgrade/restore review; any exclusions named as profile limits, not full parity.

slices.title: Pin the newer Enterprise target and inventory
slices.acceptance: Freeze an exact newer release/edition and public behavior snapshot; expand beyond the three discovery examples.

slices.title: Evaluate logical cross-cluster replication
slices.acceptance: Specify loop prevention, conflict policy, deletion/schema handling, transactions and convergence; do not equate this with physical replication.

slices.title: Evaluate native row-level security
slices.acceptance: Default-deny and role combinations, write checks, prepared plans, views/joins, backup and CDC data-exposure tests; no proxy-only equivalence.

slices.title: Evaluate vector and index compatibility
slices.acceptance: Pin APIs and exact/approximate contracts; recall/latency/memory evidence under concurrent writes, faults and upgrades.

slices.title: Research courtesy features from other database ecosystems
slices.acceptance: Source-backed ideas, existing-support inventory, user value, relative cost/risk and dependencies; no implementation implied.
